### Why a White Claw Hangover Happens

- **Dehydration:** Alcohol causes the body to lose fluids, leading to classic hangover symptoms like headaches, dizziness, and fatigue.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXF3Dv597DSzSd5uQGlVF_6ckxhQgCKJJAGK8cF6n-CiPJcrv2t2li6b5A-CL-QUxen3vGf7Z_wqVSb-obsyvMbtcErq2bcb0dH_NSwx-twzEMh78pyeF1CPgiS8Gv80wymHL49fdz2eBupCnv4J5Wz3LSnWqshA)
- **Fast Drinking:** Because White Claw tastes light, sweet, and carbonated, it is easy to drink quickly without realizing how much alcohol you are consuming.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXRIviNvXlspebIbiPTEBnIqgR0wW_KaLxh_kM2s6rDIpjcDvnosMru8B12-8fSYbKS7tF7UgGvTk_qrRESfamQqhjpEFpZdVvyWCR4NTOMVorMh1qqRW2dCQrvTdueMJkeXpAlClCpg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF19Z-kuXVMD7Br2Cgf_UAD4v2r748KFAvKQ7wV8FtWLKg5DcNiDkh-Mdy5UjTRqQTiOOGlZnIKlAYNYDjdFqJU4Mt3XJ2AHc8O4u6-3sLZkfCMef8VyDs45OCODrKH5lVVneHqA-AFFh2kcbCzE6ew0cahhFjlrruUyM9mK2O8as3yC3qDiUq0Bf7cfMocKwvLSzFtvdOifrvTa1lmG0ADA)
- **Carbonation:** Bubbles can speed up alcohol absorption into your bloodstream.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF19Z-kuXVMD7Br2Cgf_UAD4v2r748KFAvKQ7wV8FtWLKg5DcNiDkh-Mdy5UjTRqQTiOOGlZnIKlAYNYDjdFqJU4Mt3XJ2AHc8O4u6-3sLZkfCMef8VyDs45OCODrKH5lVVneHqA-AFFh2kcbCzE6ew0cahhFjlrruUyM9mK2O8as3yC3qDiUq0Bf7cfMocKwvLSzFtvdOifrvTa1lmG0ADA)
- **Lower Congeners:** White Claw generally has fewer congeners (toxic byproducts from fermentation found in dark liquors and red wine) than heavier drinks, which is why some people report milder headaches. However, consensus on forums like [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF1ztgWsz6u-gBUlUf8oSevmW6fnvx0Jl96o6gHBXtMp8JzUfNrKYAsW6Cp5xTlHjqGPW18_tnfO-TtwNQlAexoYyd72WSVcO7RgGq9fsaUtQyrkDMRv9wAnO0rWIakXrZDEJu4g1wIjkEBDeFceJ9wexlBSPwg8kG2uVrRQxU1hhrLzl4qrO6GOczQYUgUZlg5xuVU-irrmIqf5N1MBecqpM) shows that total volume and lack of water intake still dictate how bad you feel.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF19Z-kuXVMD7Br2Cgf_UAD4v2r748KFAvKQ7wV8FtWLKg5DcNiDkh-Mdy5UjTRqQTiOOGlZnIKlAYNYDjdFqJU4Mt3XJ2AHc8O4u6-3sLZkfCMef8VyDs45OCODrKH5lVVneHqA-AFFh2kcbCzE6ew0cahhFjlrruUyM9mK2O8as3yC3qDiUq0Bf7cfMocKwvLSzFtvdOifrvTa1lmG0ADA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF1x3c_WC7QfkqB0Sa2JZCtpH_wZNf9hJnYCE0ChUjwJuF2IzshjZOKG7YS3KWBSZI6cLc57ouafT9ghYBQDYTcrzR5QnzL5QsXfgu7QnUhXZfIj_BHIbflIy3SWdr6GOO8XGBignT9fDMKMEBbLN-FoD8Fbsv0Llp0HvStPAkeh3xGx0gGDd-xvXXQj4qLFnM65F9FgWqoKpuEi1yO-t35hpU)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF1ztgWsz6u-gBUlUf8oSevmW6fnvx0Jl96o6gHBXtMp8JzUfNrKYAsW6Cp5xTlHjqGPW18_tnfO-TtwNQlAexoYyd72WSVcO7RgGq9fsaUtQyrkDMRv9wAnO0rWIakXrZDEJu4g1wIjkEBDeFceJ9wexlBSPwg8kG2uVrRQxU1hhrLzl4qrO6GOczQYUgUZlg5xuVU-irrmIqf5N1MBecqpM)
- **Binge Drinking Risks:** Heavy, rapid consumption of hard seltzers can cause severe dehydration or electrolyte imbalances.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESxAEBxCJF15-kOAcEGWiAbD37U3EX6ivbGSh5YIKR2e8X54NIH5A9_GzX0I3Pxo86oObIXEidpwM1hOHbyHm1sT2gabhWaeNpkUd8gYO3BzIoHDXaNFSxydupsQztzW1xLQXiZKZK4phgXrOPhtefAlT60mTt4T0Rhv-Dyt0xc-2Opm1xXQ_S0m0rhHUcUXgzOXpGb4GxAiOXZm1VzrVlPG3GeFjsuH0WdtwxAXlPLadDv2XRq_LJrr3TWVU_m-1T3YMSW8F5)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXF3Dv597DSzSd5uQGlVF_6ckxhQgCKJJAGK8cF6n-CiPJcrv2t2li6b5A-CL-QUxen3vGf7Z_wqVSb-obsyvMbtcErq2bcb0dH_NSwx-twzEMh78pyeF1CPgiS8Gv80wymHL49fdz2eBupCnv4J5Wz3LSnWqshA)

- **Pace Yourself:** Sip drinks slowly rather than treating them like soda water.
- **Alternate with Water:** Drink a full glass of plain water between each White Claw.
- **Eat First:** Never drink on an empty stomach to slow down alcohol absorption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF19Z-kuXVMD7Br2Cgf_UAD4v2r748KFAvKQ7wV8FtWLKg5DcNiDkh-Mdy5UjTRqQTiOOGlZnIKlAYNYDjdFqJU4Mt3XJ2AHc8O4u6-3sLZkfCMef8VyDs45OCODrKH5lVVneHqA-AFFh2kcbCzE6ew0cahhFjlrruUyM9mK2O8as3yC3qDiUq0Bf7cfMocKwvLSzFtvdOifrvTa1lmG0ADA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpgEBxCJF1x3c_WC7QfkqB0Sa2JZCtpH_wZNf9hJnYCE0ChUjwJuF2IzshjZOKG7YS3KWBSZI6cLc57ouafT9ghYBQDYTcrzR5QnzL5QsXfgu7QnUhXZfIj_BHIbflIy3SWdr6GOO8XGBignT9fDMKMEBbLN-FoD8Fbsv0Llp0HvStPAkeh3xGx0gGDd-xvXXQj4qLFnM65F9FgWqoKpuEi1yO-t35hpU)
